finding.claim: Shebang parsing uses split(' ', 2), so any interpreter arguments beyond the first are dropped, and for non-env interpreters the interpreter plus argument are returned as a single space-containing file path which cannot resolve correctly.
finding.title: Shebang interpreter arguments truncated and combined into file path

verifier.reason: The code at arguments/command-file.js:156 uses split(' ', 2), which discards all tokens after the second, and at arguments/command-file.js:157-162 it returns only the single argument for env or a space-joined `${interpreter} ${argument}` string as the interpreter value described at arguments/command-file.js:147-149, confirming truncation and the space-containing return.
